note: Two-component reuse (unchecked-lowlevel + unchecked-send) covers the bulk of cases; the state-variable-storage loophole is a known, documented gap requiring a stricter custom predicate if full precision is needed later.

implementation_status.note: Both reused detectors (covering call/delegatecall/staticcall via UncheckedLowLevel, send via UncheckedSend) are implemented and tested. The documented state-variable-storage loophole (a return value stored but never branched on is treated as 'checked' by Slither's own heuristic) remains open -- a stricter custom predicate to close it is not yet built.
